company.name: OfOne
company.shortDescription: OfOne is an AI-powered drive-thru system that helps restaurant operators reduce labor costs and deliver better customer experiences.
company.description: OfOne develops an AI-powered drive-thru system designed to support restaurant operations by automating order taking and customer interactions at the drive-thru. The company’s technology uses speech recognition and conversational artificial intelligence to receive orders, interpret customer requests, and transmit them directly to restaurant point-of-sale and kitchen systems. Its platform is built to handle menu variations, modifiers, and follow-up questions while maintaining consistent order flow during peak and off-peak hours. OfOne’s system integrates with existing restaurant infrastructure, enabling operators to deploy automation without restructuring core operational processes. The solution supports real-time order processing, accuracy checks, and data capture that help streamline front-of-house workflows. OfOne’s technology is used by restaurant operators seeking to manage staffing demands, standardize drive-thru interactions, and maintain operational continuity through automated order management.
